normalized.description: Description: VITO has installed a seismic monitoring network around its geothermal site in Mol, Belgium, mainly consisting of borehole stations. The network includes 4 stations managed by the Royal Observatory of Belgium. VITO plans the addition of an extra station later in 2025. The current contract will include monitoring of seismicity based on data collected from all stations, and maintenance of the stations managed by VITO. The contract has been divided into the following items: • Monitoring • Maintenance Delivery place: Monitoring will take place from the premises of the contractor.
